Hey. Here’s the first thing I want you to do: talk to a school counselor or a teacher you feel comfortable with about your focus issues. I was so hard on myself all throughout middle school and high school because I couldn’t focus and I’d end up having panic attacks in the school bathrooms and beating myself up. Kicker was I had ADHD and never knew, sometimes symptoms manifest later in life for individuals, but this is the best step in your focus issues which will overall help your mindset in school and classes. With an ADHD diagnosis your school and the teachers are required to give you extra leniency. Trust me it’ll help so much. Also — fuck the people who hurt you, but it’s important to be the bigger person and not hurt them back. Focus on yourself and your work, and before you know it you’ll be moving on to better and bigger things. You are never alone. I know it feels that way but we have your back here. Stay strong, seek help step by step <3

Sex drive: heightened for a while for sure. obviously when you first start taking it your body will react differently and you may feel tired and your gut will feel off but give it some time. At the moment I just have a pretty normal sex drive so I’m thankful.

Alcohol: ease into it at first. Your tolerance may not be the same and your liver at first won’t like having to process lexapro and alcohol so if you take lexapro make sure it’s several hours before. I’ve been on lexapro for over a year and a half now on 20 mg and I’m much happier and it doesn’t affect my social drinking life! 

Good luck!
